summary: End-to-end regression for the 6-item roadmap ship (F1 Wallet breakdown+deposit, F2 Inventory tab+privacy toggle, F3 Trades tab, F4 Price Alerts CRUD, F5 Make-Offer button, F6 Verified card + badges, F7 Admin status/premium controls, F8 backend contract smoke tests). Backend: 6/6 pytest passing. Frontend: all documented data-testids render and behave as spec'd; wallet deposit persists payment_method=crypto, Available jumps $0 → $50 with a Crypto row in ledger; Price Alert create + delete round-trip works; Admin user detail shows both new 3-way status and 4-way premium groups and existing moderator/ban controls still render; Make Offer redirects logged-out users to Steam OpenID as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: MemberPanel.jsx is now 1253 lines (WalletTab, TransactionsTab, InventoryTab, PriceAlertsTab, BuyOrdersTab, OffersTab, NotifPrefsTab, ProfileTab all in one file). This exceeds the 700-line split threshold — split each tab into its own file under /pages/member/ for maintainability. High priority.
server.py is 3471 lines — should be split (auth, wallet, listings, admin, price-alerts routers).
AdminPage.jsx setStatus uses window.prompt() for the restriction reason. Works, but not stylistically consistent with the rest of the app that uses Dialog/Toast; consider a proper modal.
Price alert delete uses window.confirm() — same UX inconsistency comment as above.

In InventoryTab (line 685-687) the filter labels 'Listed (...)' vs 'Available (...)' use the label 'Available' for unlisted items but the underlying test id is `inv-filter-unlisted`. Not a bug, just a mismatch between UI copy and test id that may confuse future test authors.
GET /me/profile response nests fields under `data.profile` — several tests may naïvely expect them at top-level. Consider documenting or flattening a small subset.
